messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] hmc_refactor ready for merge?
parts:
I added new unit tests for all of the file includes and mutators in the new hmc_refactor code, as well as a few tests for some of the individual algorithmic elements (namely momentum sampling). Everything (including the existing unit tests as well as the model and command tests) passes, so once RStan has been updated we're ready to merge.

I'll be out of town and without my computer until Tuesday, but if there are any pressing issues I should be checking email occasionally.
